display_long_description:
A gardening adventure. Halloween is here, and GRO's owners are at WAR!

[media]
# 5 NEW SEEDS ARE HERE!
Grow Spooky Mushroom, Spooky Beanstalk, Candy Corn, Mythic Mummy and Venus Fly Trap! Collect them all and build the spookiest garden in GRO!
# UNCLORD VS OVERLORD!
GRO's OG owner is back! Vote for Unclord or Overlord in the biggest election yet. Who will rule GRO?
[media]
# TRICK OR TREAT!
Whack monsters to earn BOO Bucks! Unlock exclusive Halloween rewards and discover spooky surprises across the map!

# GIVEAWAYS AND LIVE EVENTS
Give away rare seeds, trade with friends and join the wildest VR community! Win exclusive rewards in live events.
[media]
# NEW HALLOWEEN SKINS
Dress up in spooky new skins! Unlock Halloween bundles, powerful plants and exclusive cosmetics.

Become a **GRO BRO: https://discord.gg/gro**
